name: ai-token-saver-all
description: Recommend a Best Choice and a Budget Choice on Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini or Grok from a live guide, with a Revision citation. Guidance updates on use.

interface.shortDescription: Choose models with less waste, on any platform
interface.longDescription: For people who use more than one AI platform. Get a Best Choice and a Budget Choice for your task across the AI platforms you use, based on the live Model Value Map. Compare task-specific evidence and API benchmark cost, verify the result and cite the Revision. One setup prompt adds the guidance to your instructions on each platform and one task per platform that refreshes it every two weeks. Savings depend on the task and are not guaranteed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recommend a model and effort for my task on this platform using current guidance. Cite the Revision.
